ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives the dissolution equilibrium of zinc iodate as Zn(IO3)2(s) ⇌ Zn2+(aq) + 2 IO3−(aq), and labels Ksp = 4.0 × 10^-6 at 25°C. Reasoning: The problem asks for the approximate molar solubility of zinc iodate at 25°C. Let the molar solubility of Zn(IO3)2 be s M, then at equilibrium [Zn2+] = s and [IO3−] = 2s. According to the solubility product expression Ksp = [Zn2+][IO3−]^2 = s(2s)^2 = 4s^3. Substituting Ksp = 4.0 × 10^-6 gives 4s^3 = 4.0 × 10^-6, so s^3 = 1.0 × 10^-6, s = 1.0 × 10^-2 M.
